events.title: IRUNPH Agri Run 2026

location.name: Central Park, Filinvest Alabang
location.runtime: Central Park, Filinvest Alabang, Muntinlupa City

events.tagline: Following the success of the iRunPH South Run in partnership with Nustar, we continue our mission of transforming every
description: Following the success of the iRunPH South Run in partnership with Nustar, we continue our mission of transforming every stride into something that truly matters with the iRunPH Agri Run 2026.

This is more than a race—it is a movement that brings the spotlight to our local farmers. Through this event, we directly support farming communities by purchasing their fresh produce and sharing it with our finishers, turning every medal moment into a meaningful act of giving back.

Agri Run is also a call to awareness—honoring the hardworking yet often unseen hands that sustain our tables every day. With every kilometer, we amplify their stories, uplift their livelihoods, and remind ourselves that running has the power to create real impact beyond the finish line.
Run that matters. Run with gratitude.

events.title: IRUNPH
events.tagline: Join the Movement: I RUN PH 2025 - Run for a Resilient Philippines
description: Join the Movement: I RUN PH 2025 - Run for a Resilient Philippines
This July 13, 2025, iHeartPH proudly marks a decade of impact with I RUN PH: a 10th season celebration that brings together passion, purpose, and the power of community.
Whether you're a seasoned athlete or taking your first stride, this fun run welcomes everyone who believes in the strength of movement, the joy of shared stories, and the spirit of resilience.
Proceeds from the event will go to Habitat for Humanity, helping build safe and sustainable homes for Filipino families in need.
Run with us, for health, for hope, and for a stronger Philippines - one step, and one home, at a time.
